eoraptor-dawn-dinosaur.description: A slender, long-tailed, two-legged dinosaur with a toothy open jaw and spiky crest-like scales runs at speed across a dry, rocky riverbank in a dim, painterly landscape of ferns, a cliff face and dead branches. A small lizard-like reptile scurries in the lower left, away from its path. Dust and pebbles fly from its feet. No text, frame or border is visible; the painting fills the canvas edge to edge.

coelophysis-pack-hunter.description: Three slender, long-necked, long-tailed bipedal dinosaurs run in a line through shallow muddy water at the edge of a dark, fern-filled forest. A fallen mossy log lies across the upper background under a grey, stormy sky. Painterly, dim lighting. No visible text, signature, border or frame; the painting runs edge to edge.

massospondylus-southern-grazer.description: A long-necked, bipedal-looking dinosaur with a small head, scaly textured skin and sharp claws stands on its hind legs with its long neck arched down toward a nest of speckled round eggs on the ground. Ferns, cycads and dense forest surround it under a dark, stormy sky. Painted in an oil-painting style with warm brown and green tones. No visible text, border or frame; the painting fills the image edge to edge.

dilophosaurus-twin-crest.description: A bipedal theropod dinosaur with a tan, scaly body and a fan-shaped orange crest on its head stands in a shallow forest stream, one foot lifted and splashing. Behind it are tall conifers, ferns and a fallen log, under a grey misty sky. No visible text, border or frame.

megalosaurus-great-lizard.description: A large, dark, scaly theropod with a long tail and a crest along its back stands on a muddy shore, mouth open to show serrated teeth. Behind it are araucaria-type conifers, ferns and driftwood, with choppy grey water to the right and a stormy sky. Two long-necked sauropods are faintly visible on the far shore. No text, signature or border is visible, and nothing is bloody.

mamenchisaurus-long-necked-giant.description: A tan-brown sauropod with an extremely long, arched neck stands in a misty forest, its small head at the top of the neck nibbling foliage from a tall conifer with spreading branches. Ferns and cycad-like plants fill the foreground, and a long tail trails at lower left. Painterly, oil-like style, with no visible text, border or frame; the painting fills the image edge to edge.

brontosaurus-thunder-lizard.description: A large long-necked sauropod with a whip-like tail stands in a shallow muddy swamp under a dark, orange-lit storm sky. Conifers stand in the distance, with ferns and palm-like plants in the foreground and mid-ground. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no text or border.

cryolophosaurus-frozen-crest.description: A dark, painterly scene of a large bipedal theropod with a fan-shaped red-tinted crest over its brow, walking through a dense forest of ferns and mossy fallen logs. Shafts of light and mist fill the background, with tall trunks and hanging vines. The image runs edge to edge with no visible text, border or frame.

diplodocus-whip-tailed-giant.description: A large long-necked sauropod with a spiked ridge along its back and a very long tail curling up into a stormy dark sky, grazing low among ferns. A second sauropod stands in the background, with conifers and tree ferns in a misty green-brown landscape. Painted in an oil-painting style, no visible text, and the painting fills the whole image edge to edge.

utahraptor-giant-raptor.description: A feathered, dinosaur-like predator with a long snout and toothy jaws crouches on a dark, craggy rock in a shadowy forest. A large curved sickle claw is raised off the ground on one foot, and its wing-like forelimbs are held out. The scene is a dim painterly oil style with brown and olive tones, and there are no visible letters, frame or wounds.

baryonyx-fish-eating-claw.description: A large dark, scaly theropod with a long narrow snout and bared teeth stands in churning river water, gripping a silver fish in its forelimb with a hooked claw. Behind it is a dense, stormy-skied swamp forest with ferns, palms and fallen logs, all in a painterly, textured style. No text, frame or border is visible, and the painting fills the whole square.

iguanodon-thumb-spiked-grazer.description: A bulky, armoured grey-brown dinosaur with a deep snout stoops in a dark forest floor, browsing a sprig of green plant with its mouth while one forelimb reaches down with a pointed thumb spike visible among the fingers. Ferns and horsetail stalks surround it, with a dim canopy of trunks behind. The style is a dark oil painting with visible brushwork. No text, no frame, no people.

sinosauropteryx-feathered-find.description: A small, fuzzy orange-brown feathered dinosaur with a long tail banded in white and orange leaps from the muddy edge of a dark, misty lake, its claws out and mouth open, with water splashing beneath its feet. A small lizard lies on the driftwood to the right. Behind are dark conifers, ferns and palms under a stormy grey sky. Painterly oil style, edge to edge, no text or border.

microraptor-four-winged-glider.description: A dark blue-black, feathered creature with long feathered wings on its arms and a feathered hind limb spread wide, gliding through a misty green forest. Sunbeams slant through tall conifer trunks, with ferns in the foreground and a dark, mossy trunk on the left. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text, border or signature.

deinonychus-terrible-claw.description: Two feathered, small bipedal theropods with raised sickle claws and spread arms leap through a dim fern forest with tall conifer trunks. A larger grey, scaly dinosaur stands on the right, and a fallen log lies in the foreground. The lighting is soft and painterly, with no visible text or frame apart from a tiny mark in the bottom right corner.

spinosaurus-sailback-swimmer.description: A large theropod with a tall sail along its back wades through dark, rippling swamp water under a stormy sky, a fish clamped in its long snout. Dense dark trees and palms fill the background. The style is a painterly oil look, with no visible text, border or frame. The image fills its edges.

giganotosaurus-giant-of-the-south.description: A large dark-brown theropod with a row of spiky ridges along its back and a long jaw full of teeth stands open-mouthed in a dim, misty landscape. Behind it a huge grey sauropod's leg and tail loom out of the fog. Dead branches and palm-like plants frame the left side under a stormy, dark sky. The painting is loose and painterly, with no visible text, border or frame.

argentinosaurus-colossal-titan.description: A huge long-necked sauropod with a small head and grey-brown wrinkled skin walks across a dry plain under heavy storm clouds with light breaking through. Two small predatory dinosaurs run in the background. Araucaria-like trees stand at the left edge and a mesa at the right. The painting is an oil-style study that fills the whole square canvas with no visible text or border.

parasaurolophus-trumpet-crest.description: A bipedal, duck-billed dinosaur with a tall, curved, hollow crest rises on a long neck, its beak open in a call. It stands in a misty forest of ferns and conifers under a dramatic orange-and-grey sky. Far back, a small group of similar dinosaurs stands near water. The painting is a dark oil-style scene with no visible text, frame or border.
